population: Public itch.io creator pages and selected game feed, not a paid buyer/seller census
unit: Documented opportunity or surface exposure, not a sale
period: Official docs checked 2026-10-27; public 2018 analytics description and 2026 feed sample
sample_frame: Official creator guidance and existing independent feed tracking

mechanisms.evidence: Initial publication date and eligibility; re-upload does not reset publish date
Direct-title search prioritized; description/body terms are not unrestricted topic-search inputs
Truthful genre, accessibility, language, platform and tags control eligible browse subsets
Legitimate user interaction, collections, follows and devlogs may influence exposure, without published weights
Page design guide describes qualitative editorial preference for custom, thoughtful page themes
Historical impression and CTR reports capture exposure and clicks, not orders

limits: No paid-order attribution or randomized feature allocation observed.
Feed sample is not an all paid-seller population.
Official browse ranking and staff-selection weights not publicly specified.
